title: Last Vancouver day, transit only, train to Seattle
summary: No car today — Granville Island by Aquabus, then Pacific Central for the 4:55pm train to Seattle.

segments.name: Segment 1 — Breakfast in Mount Pleasant
segments.blurb: Coffee and breakfast on Main Street before heading out.

stops.name: Main Street cafes
stops.note: Walk from the Airbnb, no transit needed.

segments.name: Segment 2 — Granville Island Public Market
segments.blurb: Bus or walk to the water, then Aquabus across False Creek.

stops.name: Granville Island Public Market
stops.note: Food stalls and produce, main draw.

stops.name: Lee's Donuts
stops.note: Classic donut stand inside the market.

stops.name: Oyama Sausage
stops.note: Charcuterie counter, good for a light lunch.

stops.name: Granville Island Brewing
stops.note: Tasting room a few steps from the market.

segments.name: Segment 3 — Yaletown or the Art Gallery
segments.blurb: Pick one or two, kept light with the train ahead.

stops.name: Yaletown waterfront
stops.note: Converted warehouse district, cafes and shops.

stops.name: Vancouver Art Gallery
stops.note: Downtown museum, an indoor option if raining.

segments.name: Segment 4 — Pacific Central Station, train to Seattle
segments.blurb: Missing this train wrecks tomorrow's flight home.

stops.name: Bags collected, en route to station
stops.note: 24 min by transit from Mount Pleasant — leave with margin.

stops.name: Pacific Central Station — be there by 3:40pm
stops.note: US immigration clears here before boarding. This is a hard deadline.

stops.name: Amtrak Train 519 departs 4:55pm
stops.note: Arrives Seattle King Street Station about 9:20pm.
